apply_accepted_batch.description:
Pay a Halo2 epoch batch whose aggregate is the stored `headstash-accepted` root.
Does not verify the proof.

apply_public_batch.description: Pay opened Pedersen destinations for Ethereum logs of fixed denomination indexes.

assign_public_notes.description: Owner: these nullifiers are paid only by the public batch, not the Halo2 batch.

bridge_egress_burn.description:
Option D private-bridge **egress burn** (ZEC SEAM → preauth dest).
Dual-path: `BridgeCfg.mock_verify` / cfg(test) lab, or `zk-api` + `egress_zkid`.
Spent under egress-nf-v0 domain (≠ pool-nf, ≠ bridge mint ν).

proof.description: Opaque membership / spend proof (mock or Halo2 later).

bridge_mint_note.description:
One-shot bridge mint → SEAM-NOTE-OUT note result.
Proof verify is **mock/stub** in Round 2 (`mock_verify` or cfg(test)).

proof.description: Opaque membership / reflection receipt (mock or SP1 later).

process_headstash.description: Verify claims and distribute. Each claim binds to a registered `root_id`.

register_asset.description: Register asset in **internal** registry (never mints balances).

asset_id.description: 32-byte Terp asset id (or mapped tacit id used as key).

register_eligibility_root.description:
Register an **additive** eligibility root (Poseidon-v1 only for new drops).
Owner-only. Assigns the next `root_id` and stores root + domain.

domain.description:
If omitted, uses the contract's default `distro_hash_domain` (must still
pass additive policy — Poseidon-v1 for new roots).

set_bridge_cfg.description: Owner-set bridge corridor config (dest domain, K, lag, mock_verify).

set_circuit_id.description: Owner: bind wasmvm store-circuit id used by `proof_instance_verify`.

set_denom_table.description: Owner: fixed CHT amounts for the public Ethereum path. Index `i` pays `amounts[i]`.

set_external_asset_registry.description: Optional external asset registry contract address (hook; not required for demos).

set_reflection_snapshot.description: Replace full reflection snapshot (includes K, lag, frozen).

root_id.description:
Eligibility root this claim proves under. Default `0` = genesis set.
Circuit public input `anchor` must match the registered root for this id
once Poseidon-v1 inclusion proofs are live.

e.description: Reduced EIP-191 challenge, 32 bytes. Not part of the signed prefix.

definitions.name: cosmwasm_std_binary_Binary
definitions.description:
Binary is a wrapper around Vec<u8> to add base64 de/serialization
with serde. It also adds some helper methods to help encode inline.

This is only needed as serde-json-{core,wasm} has a horrible encoding for Vec<u8>.
See also <https://github.com/CosmWasm/cosmwasm/blob/main/docs/MESSAGE_TYPES.md>.

definitions.name: cw_headstash_distro_DistroHashDomain
definitions.description:
Wire / JSON unit names are `poseidon_v1` / `sinsemilla_legacy` (cw_serde identifiers).
Human/ADR tags from [`DistroHashDomain::as_str`] are `poseidon-v1` / `sinsemilla-legacy`.

New Headstashes default to [`DistroHashDomain::PoseidonV1`].
[`DistroHashDomain::SinsemillaLegacy`] is recovery-only for pre-Poseidon trees.

poseidon_v1.description: Poseidon over `pallas::Base` — ADR default for public inclusion.

sinsemilla_legacy.description: Orchard-family Sinsemilla — legacy recovery only; not for new drops.

definitions.name: cosmwasm_std_math_uint128_Uint128

dest_domain.description: Terp destination domain / chain bind (32 bytes).

egress_zkid.description:
Circuit id for Option D egress `proof_instance_verify` (production path).
Lab / mock_verify ignores this. Default `None` keeps existing BridgeCfg JSON valid.

mock_verify.description:
When true, proof verify is mocked (always-ok membership under claim flags).
Production must set false and wire real verify.

definitions.name: cw_headstash_bridge_BridgeMintClaimPublic
definitions.description: Mint-critical public claim fields (Domain B §9 + C §3.1).

burn_dest_commitment.description: Burn-bound destCommitment recorded in burn set (A6).

in_burn_set.description: ν present in bridge-burn set under snapshot.burn_root.

in_pool_root.description: Burned note membership under pool root.

rcm.description: Optional opening trapdoor; non-zero → note rcm_flag=1.

spent_only.description: True if ν is only in spent set (H-1 reject when !in_burn_set).

definitions.name: cw_headstash_egress_EgressBurnStatement
definitions.description:
Public statement for Option D burn on Terp (+ lab openings for structural ν / dest).

Layout mirrors pure `EgressBurnPublic` + witness openings (`rcm`, `owner_binding`)
so the contract can fail-closed on dest equality and nullifier re-derive without
a full ZK circuit this wave.

definitions.name: cw_headstash_egress_DestKind
definitions.description: Zcash receiver class — metadata for wallet API selection; binding stays 32B seal.

blind.description: Canonical Pallas scalar, 32 bytes. Not zero.

nullifier.description: 32-byte nullifier reserved for the public path.
